This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
A fashion designer receives a mysterious sewing machine that harbors a dark spirit hellbent on her destruction.
"Sewing Machine" by Tyler Hagen
Connect with the Filmmakers:
More About "Sewing Machine":
Heather, a young fashion designer, is working on her latest collection when a knock at the door changes everything. Left on her doorstep is a mysterious sewing machine, seemingly a gift - but it carries a lot more with it than just bad vibes.
